entities.name: Query protein 768 aa
observations: Sequence length is 768 aa; predicted molecular mass is 83.29 kDa and theoretical pI is 4.81.
Pfam matches: tRNA_bind (45–127), B3_4 (222–391), B5 (413–477), tRNA_synthFbeta (480–692), and FDX-ACB (710–768).
Sequence matches reviewed Streptococcus thermophilus phenylalanine-tRNA ligase beta subunits at 100% identity and 100% query coverage; target coverage is 95.8%.
Strong homology support assigns the protein as the beta subunit of phenylalanine-tRNA ligase (EC 6.1.1.20), not as an independent aminoacylation enzyme.

entities.name: Phenylalanyl-tRNA aminoacylation
observations: Chemical equation: tRNA(Phe) + L-phenylalanine + ATP = L-phenylalanyl-tRNA(Phe) + AMP + diphosphate + H(+).
The reaction is catalyzed by the phenylalanine-tRNA ligase complex, containing two alpha and two beta subunits.
